items.description: Upper River Derwent, Stonethwaite Beck and Derwent Water
items.message:
Due to Derwent Water remaining high following recent rainfall a Flood Alert will remain in force.  Derwent Water level is currently receding and will continue to do so over the coming days as high pressure builds bringing a period of settled and dry weather.  
Locations most affected will be low lying land and roads near the Upper Derwent from Seathwaite to Derwent Water. 
We continue to closely monitor the situation. Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water. This message will be updated by 9:00AM on Friday 30 October or as the situation changes.

items.description: The tidal Rivers Bure, Ant and Thurne
items.message:
Higher than normal tides today may lead to flooding. Flooding is possible from 12 noon to 3pm today, Thursday 29 October. 
We expect to see high water levels around Potter Heigham, Wroxham boat yards and Ferry Road in Horning. Levels can take several hours to peak. The weather forecast is improving, and we expect levels to start returning to normal soon. We are monitoring rainfall and river levels. Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water. This message will be updated by 10am on Friday 30 October  or as the situation changes.
